items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was doing a string date with Milt Jackson

ctx.x: Oh, I'm glad Norman taped it. I wonder what he's going to do with it.

I don't know. He'll probably release it someway, because I went to his office one day. You know, I was doing a string date with Milt Jackson, and Norman had so much stuff on Duke that he'd gotten from Mercer that hadn't been released. So I imagine he's going to release all this stuff.
Yeah, he's already released some of it, I know, that he got from Mercer.
